D2_MAIN.statement: B=(Z_2[x,y]/(2-2x+x^2+xy-y^2))_(2,x,y) is dimension-two regular local with residue F_2 and ord_m(2)=2. There is integral c in K_3(B) zero over Frac B but nonzero modulo two in G_3(B[1/2];Z/2). No order, rationalization, henselization or completion claim is included.
D2_MAIN.evidence_kind: complete mathematical proof from explicit published inputs; independent review pending

D2_MODEL.statement: The corrected dyadic conic has integral generic fiber. B is regular with ord_m(2)=2; S=Z_2[t]/(t^2-2t+2) is a DVR, eta=1-t satisfies eta^2=-1, and N(t)=2. Points specializing away from m have even residue degree.

D2_FIELD.statement: For every finite E/Q_2 the actual mixed product theta_E(u)=beta_E*[u] is an isomorphism E^*/E^{*2}->K_3(E;Z/2). The unique degree-three etale H1 piece proves exponent two; no mod-two Moore ring or exponent-two assertion about K_2 is used.

D2_LIFTS.statement: The Steinberg identity {-1,t}=2{eta,1-eta}=0 gives an integral K_3(D) lift; K_2(F_2)=0 gives a K_3(S) lift. Its coherent pushforward c is integrally generically zero and rho(c|_T)=i_*a_D.

D2_TRANSFER.statement: Transfer of theta_E(u) equals theta_Q2(N(u)); lambda kills every transferred coefficient class at even residue degree, while the distinguished divisor has detector value one.

D2_OPENS.statement: T is the inverse limit of the affine flat opens U_h. Coherent G-theory with Moore coefficients is continuous, each U_h contains q0, and all omitted points have even residue degree.

D2_DETECTION.statement: Coherent localization and proper pushforward would give detector values zero and one if (q0)_*a_D vanished at T; hence its restriction is nonzero.

D2_ODD_RESIDUE.statement: The same dyadic theorem holds over the integers of every unramified H/Q_2 of odd degree d, with finite residue F_(2^d), dimension two and ord_m(2)=2.
D2_ODD_RESIDUE.evidence_kind: parameterized proof using the exact Frobenius period, not finite extrapolation

D2_ALGEBRA_CERT.statement: The standalone exact replay checks seven algebra/index groups and rejects ten false inputs; the exact norm polynomial agrees with the retained typed Jacobian result. It does not mechanically verify the K-theoretic theorem.
D2_ALGEBRA_CERT.evidence_kind: exact executable algebra; independent replay pending

D2_PRIOR_SCOPE.statement: No inspected primary statement entails the conjunction of dimension two, finite residue F_2, integral K_3 generic vanishing and the stated mod-two detection. Existing asserted dyadic integral examples include dimension two with residue F_2(T) and dimension three with residue F_2. This bounded comparison does not certify exhaustive novelty or publishability.
D2_PRIOR_SCOPE.evidence_kind: primary-statement comparison by a separate research agent; not theorem review

C9000209.statement: Adversarially audit, verify, or refute OpenAI Manuscript Family 209 ('An integral degree-three Gersten counterexample', unformalized in Lean), which claims that for X: (X-Z)^5 - X*Y^4 + Y^5 + zeta*Z^5 = 0 over Z_5[zeta] at m=[0:0:1], A=O_{X,m} is a 2D regular local ring where K_3(A) -> K_3(Frac A) has nonzero kernel: either (a) discover and certify a flaw, regularity/ramification error, symbol/transfer cancellation error, or invalid localization/detection step in sections/model.tex, sections/integral-class.tex, sections/field.tex, or sections/detection.tex with an exact symbolic certificate, or (b) independently verify and certify every algebraic, p-adic, and K-theoretic step with an exact replay certificate.

D3_MODEL.statement: The cyclotomic quintic gives the regular ramified surface, integral generic curve, residue-degree obstruction away from m, and the distinguished Eisenstein DVR S with N(t)=pi and (1-t)^5=zeta.

D3_INTEGRAL.statement: The coefficient class beta_D*[t] lifts to K_3(D), then K_3(S); pushforward to K_3(A) is generically zero and restricts to i_*a_D modulo five on T.

D3_FIELD.statement: For every finite E/L, the actual product theta_E(u)=beta_E*[u] is an isomorphism E^*/E^{*5} -> K_3(E;Z/5), identified with alpha_E cup Kummer(u), alpha_E nonzero.

D3_NORM.statement: Transfer of theta_E(u) equals theta_L(N_E/L u); lambda kills every transferred coefficient class when the residue degree is divisible by five.

D3_OPENS.statement: T is the inverse limit of affine flat opens U_h; coefficient G-theory is continuous. All omitted points specialize away from m and have residue degree divisible by five.

D3_DETECTION.statement: The class (q0)_*theta_D(t) cannot vanish on T: its proper pushforward has detector value one, whereas any localization relation from omitted points has value zero.

D3_MAIN.statement: For the specified two-dimensional regular local A of mixed characteristic (0,5), an integral c in K_3(A) is zero over Frac(A) but nonzero modulo five on A[1/pi]. Its order and rational image are not determined.

D3_ALGEBRA_CERT.statement: The standalone exact replay verifies the polynomial, Frobenius, matrix norm, finite-field symbol, spectral-index and detector arithmetic for p=5,d=1, without claiming to compute or formally verify K-theory.

D3_RAMIFICATION.statement: For the September 26 ring, ord_m(pi)=5 and ord_m(5)=20, with initial form xbar^5-xbar*ybar^4+ybar^5.

D3_UNIFORM.statement: For every odd prime p and d>=1 with p not dividing d, over the integers of H(zeta_p) with H/Q_p unramified of degree d, the local ring at [0:0:1] of (X-Z)^p-X*Y^(p-1)+Y^p+zeta_p*Z^p=0 is regular of dimension two, has ord_m(pi)=p and ord_m(p)=p*(p-1), and has an integral degree-three generic kernel class nonzero modulo p after inverting pi.
D3_UNIFORM.evidence_kind: parameterized mathematical proof, not finite extrapolation
D3_UNIFORM.qualification: Not inferred from the p=5 instance alone. Novelty and publishable significance remain unverified.

D5_MOORE.statement: The mod-five Moore pairing is unital and unique as asserted, five acts trivially, and the coefficient products are natural.

D5_BOTT_LOCALIZATION.statement: Bott multiplication commutes with the stated localization, transfer and flat pullback operations.

D5_BOTT.statement: For perfect H containing mu_5 with characteristic not five, Bott periodicity holds in even degrees 2r for r>=1 when cd_5 H<=3, odd degrees 2r+1 for r>=0 when cd_5 H<=2, and all nonnegative degrees for finite H.

D5_UNRAMIFIED.statement: A K_2(N)/5 class unramified at every closed point of Spec Z[zeta_5,1/5] is zero.

D5_INTEGRAL.statement: b^2[u]_5 lifts to K_5(S), with reduction of delta(c) equal to chi(delta)^2 b^2[delta u]_5 after all field restrictions.

D5_ORBIT.statement: The specified elliptic quotient admits an orbit point with weighted Picard detector sum 4Q nonzero modulo five.

D5_LOCAL_RING.statement: A is regular local of dimension two and maps onto O via x=tX0,y=tY0 with height-one principal kernel (Y0*x-X0*y).

D5_SPLITTING.statement: The flat generic base change is an integral regular curve localization; the divisor splits into four L-points with the stated cyclotomic specializations.

D5_SPECIALIZATION.statement: Under the full smooth proper curve, omitted-specialization and Picard-map hypotheses recorded in D5_CTX and D5_SPECIALIZATION in MATH_STATE, a nonzero valuation-weighted Picard sum detects the supported G_5 coefficient class.

D5_MAIN.statement: For the September 25 ring A, the integral degree-five generic restriction has nonzero kernel.

D5_TRIANGULAR.statement: The appendix's block-matrix assignments fail the specified functoriality test. This is not a refutation of the cited theorem and is not an input to either Gersten kernel proof.

F209_VOEVODSKY_617_TRUNCATED_ETALE_TARGE.statement: In OpenAI Family 209 (Integral degree-three Gersten counterexample), Voevodsky (2011) Theorem 6.17 alone identifies motivic cohomology in weights j>=s with truncated etale cohomology H^s_et(E, mu_5^{tensor j}) without invoking Suslin (2003) Corollary 7.5 and Theorem 7.6.

F209_DYADIC_Y0_EISENSTEIN_SUBSTITUTION.statement: In OpenAI Family 209, substituting the odd-prime y=0 slice directly into the dyadic (0,2) cyclotomic model produces a nonzero constant term and norm of t supplying an Eisenstein divisor.
